slides.title: Sudan takes drone complaint against Ethiopia to the UN
Complaints filed at the UN and African Union
slides.body: Sudan's foreign ministry said late Sunday it had complained to the UN Security Council and the AU Peace and Security Council.

slides.title: civilians killed or wounded, Sudan's army-led council says
slides.body: Its report counts 70 attacks with 187 drones, Feb 15 to Oct 27, 2026. Claims not independently verified.

slides.title: Sites named: Asosa, Kurmuk-Gizen border area, Bahir Dar
slides.body: Sudan says drones used by the RSF took off from Ethiopian soil. In May, Ethiopia called such accusations "baseless."

slides.title: civilians killed at Wad el-Mahi, Sudan says
slides.body: 26 women and four children were reported killed in an Oct 9 attack on displaced families near the Ethiopian border.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Al Jazeera, Nov 2, 2026; Radio Tamazuj, May 6, 2026
